title: Invite your friends + dark-mode fix
notes: Members can now invite friends via a personal referral link or by email, with sign-ups credited back to them (toggle under Admin → Invites). Also fixes code blocks in the docs showing as a white box with invisible text in dark mode.

changelog.text: Members can invite friends — a personal referral link + email invitations, with referral attribution. New “Invite friends” page in the account menu.
Documentation code blocks (and the homepage terminal) were a white box with invisible text in dark mode — now dark with readable text.
